LLM_OVERRIDE_NOTICE = (
    "# An LLM provider edited in the app (Settings > Project > Models) is stored in the app",
    "# database and takes precedence over this block until it is deleted there.",
)


def annotate_llm_override(config_path: Path) -> None:
    """Note, above the saved `llm` block, that editing a provider in the app overrides it."""
    content = config_path.read_text()
    lines = content.splitlines()
    index = next((i for i, line in enumerate(lines) if line.rstrip() == "llm:"), None)
    if index is None:
        return

    lines[index:index] = LLM_OVERRIDE_NOTICE
    trailing_newline = "\n" if content.endswith("\n") else ""
    config_path.write_text("\n".join(lines) + trailing_newline)

def test_annotate_llm_override_comments_above_the_llm_block(tmp_path):
    config_path = tmp_path / "nao_config.yaml"
    config_path.write_text("project_name: test-project\nllm:\n  providers:\n  - provider: openai\n")

    annotate_llm_override(config_path)

    assert config_path.read_text() == (
        "project_name: test-project\n"
        f"{LLM_OVERRIDE_NOTICE[0]}\n"
        f"{LLM_OVERRIDE_NOTICE[1]}\n"
        "llm:\n"
        "  providers:\n"
        "  - provider: openai\n"
    )


def test_annotate_llm_override_is_noop_without_llm_block(tmp_path):
    config_path = tmp_path / "nao_config.yaml"
    original = "project_name: test-project\ndatabases: []\n"
    config_path.write_text(original)

    annotate_llm_override(config_path)

    assert config_path.read_text() == original

content.text:
Done. The precedence is DB (UI) → `nao_config.yaml` → env vars, so anything saved from the settings form permanently shadows the file, and I surfaced that in both places.

**In the UI** (`apps/frontend/src/components/settings/llm-provider-form.tsx`): an amber warning now appears at the top of the edit form whenever the provider is inherited from `nao_config.yaml` — which covers both the "Override openai" form for a provider that only exists in the file, and the "Edit openai" form for one that already has a database override. It tells the user that saving here wins over the file until they delete the provider from the app. Providers inherited from env vars don't get the banner, since the form already explains that case in the API key hint.

**In the config file**: the note is written above the `llm:` block. I added it to `example/nao_config.yaml` and made `nao init` emit it too, via a new `annotate_llm_override` in `cli/nao_core/config/base.py` that mirrors the existing `annotate_optional_templates` post-processing step (necessary because `save()` dumps YAML wholesale and can't carry comments). Two tests cover it, and the auto-generated configuration reference gained a matching sentence in the LLM section.

Wording used in the YAML, kept short enough to stay readable at two lines:

```yaml
# An LLM provider edited in the app (Settings > Project > Models) is stored in the app
# database and takes precedence over this block until it is deleted there.
llm:
```

`make lint` plus the CLI config/init tests (92 passed) and the frontend `tsc --noEmit && eslint` all pass.

One thing worth flagging: the note only reaches configs written by `nao init`, so projects created before this change won't get it. `nao migrate` rewrites the `llm` block as text and would be the natural place to backfill it if you want existing users to see it — say the word and I'll add it there.
